title: 🔥BTC.D走高揭示避险逻辑
body: 市场处于存量资金避险阶段。BTC.D 报 58.9%，7 日变化 +0.9%。在价格小幅反弹背景下，dominance 逆势拉升，表明资金正从山寨币撤出回流比特币。流动性向头部资产集中反映了风险偏好极低，场内结构不支持普涨行情。中性。山寨季还有希望吗？
body_en: The market is currently in a risk-off phase, trading on existing liquidity. BTC.D sits at 58.9%, up 0.9% over the last 7 days. Despite a slight price rebound, dominance is bucking the trend—this signals capital is rotating out of altcoins and flowing back into BTC. Liquidity concentrating in top-tier assets reflects extremely low risk appetite, and the current market structure simply doesn't support a broad rally. Neutral. Is there any hope left for altseason?
